parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Okehi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 697.56 | 0.29506 | 0.29506
2 | 10642 | 0.51943 | 0.81449
3 | 5533 | 35.32 | 39.13
4 | 5776.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Okehi
Curve type: KH
Aquifer depth: 0.81 m – 39.13 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive layer (5533 Ω·m) between approximately 0.81 m and 39.13 m depth as the main water-bearing zone; case off the shallow, thin, highly resistive layers (0–0.81 m) to prevent collapse and seal out near-surface contamination before screening the aquifer interval.
